assets.name: スライム
assets.en: Use case: style-transfer. Create one finished transparent RPG battle monster asset. Image 1 is the identity reference: retain its squat rounded emerald-green slime body, two small dark eyes, soft uneven mound silhouette and broad pooled base. Image 2 is the rendering-style reference: match its carefully painted fantasy bestiary illustration, crisp silhouette, convincing material textures, restrained dark contours and clear directional lighting. Translate the slime into the same illustrated asset family, with translucent green jelly, subtle suspended bubbles, broad readable green light and shadow shapes, small moist highlights and an alert simple expression. Show the entire single slime in a slight three-quarter frontal view, centered in a square canvas with comfortable clear margins. The body occupies roughly 80 percent of the canvas width. The surrounding canvas and spaces outside the body are fully transparent with a clean alpha edge. Deliver the standalone creature illustration ready for a game battle screen.
assets.ja: 旧スライムの低く丸い緑の体、小さな黒い両目、広がった底部を維持します。新しい水車ビーバーと同じ描画密度・輪郭・光の方向で、半透明のゼリー、控えめな気泡と濡れた光沢を描きます。全身が収まる正方形構図、余白付き、背景透過の戦闘素材です。

assets.name: スケルトン
assets.en: Use case: style-transfer. Create one finished transparent RPG battle monster asset. Image 1 is the identity reference: retain a single upright ivory skeleton with a slightly oversized skull, dark eye sockets, visible rib cage, slender limbs, a brown belt and short worn waist cloth, holding one narrow weathered sword upright at its side. Image 2 is the rendering-style reference: match the detailed painted bone surfaces, subtle aged ivory coloration, restrained dark contours, cool shaded hollows and coherent fantasy bestiary illustration. Give the skeleton a readable ready-for-battle stance with bent knees, clear articulated anatomy and five bony digits on each hand. Keep both feet, the full sword and the skull completely inside the frame. Show the entire single creature in a slight three-quarter frontal view, centered on a square canvas with clear margins. Use broad readable light and shadow shapes with carefully chosen bone texture detail. The surrounding canvas and every open space between the bones are fully transparent with a clean alpha edge. Deliver the standalone creature illustration ready for a game battle screen.
assets.ja: 旧スケルトンの大きめの頭蓋骨、黒い眼窩、細い骨格、茶色の腰布と帯、片手の剣を維持します。骨鯨と同じ骨の質感・陰影・輪郭で描き、両手は各5指、骨格と剣の全体が収まる戦闘姿勢にします。骨の隙間を含めて背景透過の素材です。

assets.name: 構造体
assets.en: Use case: style-transfer. Create one finished transparent RPG battle monster asset. Image 1 is the identity reference: retain the short broad ancient humanoid construct, blocky muted green-gray armored body, small helmet-shaped head with a narrow amber eye slit, massive shoulders and forearms, separated squat legs, and a bright amber diamond-shaped core in the center of its chest. Image 2 is the rendering-style reference: match its detailed painted fantasy bestiary style, worn metal material, restrained dark outlines, clear three-dimensional volume and disciplined directional highlights. Depict weathered green iron plates, small old joints and fasteners, dark recesses and a softly glowing orange chest core. Preserve the original compact proportions and the two relaxed heavy arms, each with a single clearly formed mechanical hand. Show the entire single construct in a slight three-quarter frontal view, centered on a square canvas with comfortable clear margins around both feet and shoulders. Use broad readable color and shadow shapes with selected surface detail. The surrounding canvas and spaces between the limbs are fully transparent with a clean alpha edge. Deliver the standalone creature illustration ready for a game battle screen.
assets.ja: 旧構造体のずんぐりした体型、緑灰色の装甲、小さな兜状の頭、橙色の細い目、胸の菱形の核を維持します。新しい魔物素材と同じ描画で、古びた鉄板・関節・控えめな金属の光沢を表現します。両足と肩まで全体が収まり、手足の隙間も透過した戦闘素材です。
